## About
Deepa Auto Body is the Perth Amboy shop of Deepa Auto Repair, a family owned business with other locations in Piscataway and Iselin. Here on New Brunswick Ave, we focus on body work, collision repair and painting for foreign and domestic cars.
Our technicians are ASE certified, and we straighten frames and unibodies on a Data liner system before your car goes into our oven baked paint room. We hold a 4.1 rating from 34 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to take a look at your car.

## Services
- Auto body, collision and painting: Body, collision and paint work, including Data liner unibody and frame straightening with laser beam accuracy.
- Paint job warranty: We offer a written limited life time warranty on the paint job.
- Computerized diagnostic: Every Deepa location, including Perth Amboy, is equipped for computerized diagnostic.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We repair both foreign and domestic cars, including collision work.

Q: Is there a warranty on paint work?
A: Yes. We offer a written limited life time warranty on the paint job.

Q: Do you have other locations?
A: Yes. Deepa Auto Repair also has shops in Piscataway and Iselin.
